q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of soy milk?
title: Soy milk carbon footprint per litre
short: Add the soybeans used per litre with the supplier's figure, then the sugar and other ingredients, the grinding, cooking and filling energy and the packaging. Divide the plant's energy by litres filled.
audience: Soy milk and plant-based beverage makers

ul: Sugar, flavours and fortification if added.
Separating okara and pasteurising or sterilising.

p: Report per litre and include the pack. Okara sold as feed can be treated as a co-product rather than waste; say how you allocate.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per litre (one month)
lines: Plant total: 18,300 / 40,000 = 0.458 kg CO2 per litre
Add soybeans, sugar and the pack for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
